abilityText.zh: 当一只宝可梦陷入特殊状态时，你可以令其改为陷入“中毒”状态，当一只宝可梦的“中毒”状态效果被触发时，你可以令伤害值改为2点。
abilityText.en: When a Pokémon would enter a special status, you may change that status to Poison. When a Pokémon’s Poison effect triggers, you may set its damage to 2.

effectText.en: After this Pokémon deals damage with this move, make a judgment. If the result is heavy rain, the target Pokémon becomes Poisoned.
